channel.title: Bounding Into Comics - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Bounding Into Comics (boundingintocomics.com)

item.title: 'Star Wars Rebels' Writers All Agreed Sabine Wren Becoming A Jedi Was "A Bad Idea", So Of Course Disney Ignored Them For 'Ahsoka'
item.description: Despite her lightsaber skills in 'Ahsoka', Henry Gilroy says 'Star Wars Rebels' originally had no plans for Sabien Wren to go full Jedi.

item.title: Former PlayStation Boss Says Game Devs Looking To "Stand Out" Should "Take Pride In Your Culture And Leverage It"
item.description: Shuehei Yoshida believes video games, in particular those from Korea, are served best by their developers taking "pride in their "culture"

item.title: Epic Games Refutes Claims They'll "Add Gambling" To 'Fortnite' Via User-Created Loot Boxes, Calls Them "Paid Random Items" Instead
item.description: Epic Games refutes claims they'll "add gambling" to Fortnite via user created loot boxes, or "paid random items" as they call them.

item.title: Miles Teller Knew ‘Fantastic Four’ Was In Trouble, Blames An Unnamed Individual Who “F’ed It All Up”
item.description: Explore the role of Miles Teller in 2015's 'Fantastic Four' and how he recognized the film's fate before its release.

item.title: Marvel Seemingly Admits Defeat On Miles Morales Name Debate, Officially Tag Him As 'Spin' In 'Radioactive Spider-Man'
item.description: After years of insisting that 'Miles Morales is Spider-Man', Marvel has officially introduced his alternate name 'Spin' to the comics.

item.title: ‘The Dark Knight’ Trilogy Stars Michael Caine And Morgan Freeman Take Polar Opposite Stances On AI
item.description: Morgan Freeman addresses the risks of AI while Michael Caine is open to its possibilities for his enduring legacy.

item.title: Paramount Kills 'Last Ronin' Film In Favor Of Live-Action 'TMNT' Franchise From 'Sonic The Hedgehog' Producer
item.description: Paramount has reportedly traded in their 'Last Ronin' adaptation for a new 'Sonic'-style 'Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles' movie franchise.

item.title: Laid Off Rockstar Games Employees Accuse Studio Of Union Busting, File Legal Claims Against ‘Grand Theft Auto’ Developer
item.description: Fired employees issue legal claims against Rockstar Games for union busting, almost overshadowing Grand Theft Auto VI being delayed.

item.title: Brendan Fraser Slams 'Batgirl' Cancellation, Says Hollywood's Obsession With "Content" Is A "Blight" On Film Making
item.description: 'Batgirl' star Brendan Fraser still feels the burn of the DCEU film's cancellation, and the Firefly actor is letting Hollywood know.

item.title: 'The Acolyte' Creator Thinks 'Star Wars'-Related "Content" On Track To Be "More Culturally Impactful" Than Actual Films
item.description: Thanks to the internet, 'The Acolyte' creator Leslye Headland thinks 'Star Wars' content is now more relevant than the Disney IP itself.
